top_module.name: sram_mbist_demo_controller
top_module.description: Top-level scratchpad controller with MMIO-style register map, simple SRAM read/write sequencing, and BIST status/interrupt reporting while preserving explicit macro usage intent for downstream DFT and MBIST flows.
top_module.functionality: Implements a small register-mapped controller that accepts writes and reads on a simple bus, controls a 256x32 scratchpad via a dedicated SRAM wrapper child, mirrors selected memory and BIST status into readable registers, and raises an interrupt when enabled BIST completion or failure events are latched. The top remains a controller and is not a raw SRAM model.
responsibilities: Manage control, status, memory address/data, BIST control, BIST status, IRQ status, and IRQ clear registers.
Drive the SRAM wrapper child instance u_sram for functional memory access.
Present read data for memory and register locations on rd_data.
Latch BIST completion/failure indications and expose ready/busy state.
Assert irq only when IRQ_ENABLE is set and a BIST event is latched.
Preserve explicit macro integration intent for downstream synthesis/DFT/MBIST collateral generation.
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset deassertion entry, clear CONTROL, STATUS, MEM_ADDR, MEM_WDATA, MEM_RDATA, MEM_CONTROL, BIST_CONTROL, BIST_STATUS, IRQ_STATUS, ready, bist_done, bist_fail, irq, and any internal pending state; memory macro contents are not initialized by this controller.
behavior_rules: The top-level controller shall instantiate demo_sram_32x256_wrapper as child memory wrapper instance u_sram.
The controller shall never infer, substitute, or model the scratchpad as a register array.
Writes to MEM_ADDR and MEM_WDATA update the corresponding holding registers.
A write to MEM_CONTROL with MEM_WRITE asserted performs a write transaction to the wrapper using the stored MEM_ADDR and MEM_WDATA.
A read sequence initiated by rd_en and a readable address shall return register values or memory read data without exposing undocumented locations.
BIST_START may be requested by the bist_start input or by BIST_CONTROL.START; BIST_CONTROL.CLEAR_RESULT clears latched done/fail status and IRQ status bits.
STATUS.ready reflects controller availability for a new memory or BIST request; STATUS.busy is the inverse of ready when an operation is in progress.
IRQ_STATUS bits latch on BIST done/fail events and are cleared by IRQ_CLEAR or BIST_CONTROL.CLEAR_RESULT as specified.
irq asserts only when IRQ_ENABLE is set and at least one IRQ_STATUS bit is set.
The controller shall keep the functional memory access path single-ported from the controller perspective, even though the underlying macro is 1RW1R.
All BIST status registers must remain architecturally present even if downstream MBIST logic later replaces or wraps the memory path.

submodules.name: u_sram
submodules.description: Child memory wrapper instance used by the controller.

modules.name: demo_sram_32x256_wrapper
modules.description: Simple functional scratchpad wrapper that binds the controller to the qualified prebuilt Sky130 SRAM macro sky130_sram_1kbyte_1rw1r_32x256_8 via the required macro instance u_sram. The wrapper exposes one functional 1RW access path and leaves the second read port safely tied off or reserved for future MBIST wrapper integration.
